title: ham ali ke deewane hadesou me palte hai
body:
ham ali ke deewane hadesou me palte hai
qaar daar raahou par muskura ke chalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kya samajh ke ye dunya ham pe zulm karti hai
ham wo hai ke dil jin ke mout se behalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ham to kood padte hai aag me ali keh kar
baaz log hyder ke naam hi se jalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aap aur ham kya hai kya bisaat hai apni
naame murtaza lekar ambiya sambhalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
zikre murtaza cheda kya bura kiya maine
aap is tarha pehlu kis liye badalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
damane ali jin ke hath me nahi hota
wo quda raseeda bhi hoke hath malte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj le ke jayega kuch na kuch to kirmaani
saail e ali bhi kya qali hath malte hai
